summary.headline: Ranks of Astrological Weaknesses
summary.text: Classification of astrological weaknesses by rank and effect, including decreases in light, magnitude, number, calculation, and motion; cadent, malefic, fallen, aversion, besiegement, combustion, and nodal conditions; and the Sun, Moon, zodiacal signs, decans, novenaria, dodecatemoria, lots, dark degrees, and blindness degrees.
